_meta.source: Instagram, scraped with Apify apify/instagram-reel-scraper on 2026-10-22. Play counts are as of that day.
_meta.limits: Rebuilt sample, NOT the original 485-reel research. Only 3 pages gave usable data (jayroberts, ryanserhant, tomferry), all US. The Indian pages tried (sobharealty, brigadegroup, prestigeconstructions, godrejproperties, realestatebengaluru) returned nothing usable. page_median is the median plays of the reels sampled from that page in this run (jayroberts n=17, ryanserhant n=19), so multiples differ from a full-history median. hook_source says whether the hook is the spoken first line (transcript) or the first line of the caption. why_it_worked is an observation, not proof of cause.

reels.hook: Last year, I bought a site on the water for $30 million.
reels.why_it_worked: Opens with one big money figure from a real deal, then walks the sums step by step (income, costs, profit) so a viewer can follow along.

reels.hook: You can buy a 100 million dollar building with 30 million dollars of cash.
reels.why_it_worked: A surprising ratio in the first sentence ($100 million for $30 million), then one simple example that ends on a single result (a 66% return).

reels.hook: Billions of dollars are pouring into the Miami River
reels.why_it_worked: Names a place and a scale of change up front, then points to named landmark projects along the same stretch.

reels.hook: @mannyavaras has created more than $45M++ in value for Rick Ross.
reels.why_it_worked: Leads with a result in dollars and a famous name, so the viewer stays to learn how the value was created.

reels.hook: While others were making headlines, @moishemana was quietly pulling off one of the biggest land grabs in Florida history.
reels.why_it_worked: Sets up a secret-success story in one line, backs it with specific numbers (acres, number of properties), and ends on a question for comments.

reels.hook: People can’t afford their first home and their parents can’t afford to sell their last one
reels.why_it_worked: Names a problem that first-time buyers and their parents both recognise, then promises two ideas.

reels.hook: This Newport mansion has more bedrooms than most boutique hotels.
reels.why_it_worked: One unusual comparison in the first line (bedrooms vs a boutique hotel), then a tour of the standout features. A modest result compared with this page's usual views.
